messages.summary:
## Objective
- User asked in Indonesian: "Bisakah kau membuatkan aku game mirip genshin impact" — build a playable Genshin-inspired browser game.

## Requirements
- User gave no explicit constraints beyond wanting a Genshin-like game.
- Non-interactive environment; question tool failed, so assumptions were made: 3D mini open-world, desktop + mobile, browser-based, original procedural assets.
- UI language is Indonesian.

## Decisions
- Built **Aetheria — Jejak Sang Angin**, a Vite + Three.js open-world prototype.
- Core features: procedural island, two elemental characters (Aria/Anemo, Ember/Pyro), slimes, elemental reactions, combat combos, glide/sprint/swim, quest chain, minimap, mobile joystick/touch buttons, procedural audio, pause/reward/death overlays.
- No external 3D assets; all geometry/materials procedural, toon-shaded.
- Auto-detect SwiftShader/software rendering and fall back to low quality (shadows/bloom/tree density).
- Mobile joystick is forced visible at viewport width ≤700px, not only on touch devices.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project scaffolding: `package.json`, `index.html`, `src/style.css`, all game modules.
- `npm install` and `npm run build` succeed; Vite dev server runs on port 3002 via tmux session `aetheria`.
- Playwright browser installed; title and gameplay screenshots captured successfully.
- Fixed runtime error: `ReferenceError: body is not defined` in `EnemyManager.spawn`.
- Redesigned terrain for a flatter village clearing and sea bay; added ground texture, huts, fences, path, campfire, benches, tree shadow discs.
- Added quest system, minimap, HUD, dialogue, reward/pause/death UI.
- Current model state: uncommitted working tree; no git commit made.

### Active
- Visual polish/tuning after latest edits:
  - Camera changed to `fov 58`, pitch `0.17`, distance `8.8` to show more sky/mountain.
  - Path stones shrunk and density increased.
  - Rock-size exclusion near village was planned but **not yet applied**.
  - Latest camera/path changes have **not been reloaded or screenshotted/tested yet**.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload `http://localhost:3002/` via `playwright-cli -s=ae reload`, click `button[aria-label="Start"]`, screenshot desktop gameplay.
2. Inspect camera framing; verify mountain/sky visible and village composition improved.
3. Reduce/remove oversized rocks inside village radius (~16m around `(0,32)`) in `makeRocks`.
4. Test mobile viewport (390×844) and verify joystick/abilities/quest HUD fit.
5. Test core gameplay: NPC dialogue, wisp collection, slime combat, chest/reward flow.
6. Run `npm run build` again and finalize README/summary.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: bootstrap, camera/input loop, quality/start/pause wiring.
- `src/world.js`: terrain height function, village/huts, POIs, water/sky, props — most visual tuning happens here.
- `src/player.js`: movement, jump/glide/swim, combat, skills, bursts, damage.
- `src/enemies.js`: slime AI, reactions, boss, HP bars, kill/respawn.
- `src/quest.js`: quest steps, dialogue lines, wisp/kill/chest progression.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, minimap, dialogue, toasts, reward/pause/death, interaction prompt.
- `src/character.js`: procedural character models and animation.
- `src/fx.js`: particles, slash trails, vortex/explosion/meteor, damage numbers.
- `src/style.css`: full responsive/touch UI styling.
- `index.html`: all overlay/HUD markup; start button has `aria-label="Start"` for capture auto-start.
- `src/audio.js`: WebAudio ambient + SFX.
- `src/look.js`: toon materials, glow textures, seeded RNG, helpers.

## Important Context
- Dev server: `tmux new-session -d -s aetheria 'cd /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround && npm run dev'`; serves port 3002.
- Playwright CLI session: `playwright-cli -s=ae ...`; screenshots saved under `screenshots/`.
- Capture auto-start finds a visible button with `aria-label`/text matching `Start|Play`; `#btn-start` uses `aria-label="Start"`.
- On SwiftShader, quality auto-detects as `low` (no shadows/bloom, fewer trees) — screenshots will look flatter than real GPU.
- Terrain key constants: `SPAWN=(0,32)`, `NPC_POS=(6,26)`, `STATUE_POS=(-6,35)`, `CHEST_POS=(-32,-28)`, `BOSS_POS=(-28,-22)`.
- Build output needs to remain plain static or Vite; `start.sh` uses runtime default static server after `vite build`.
- Caveat: latest edits (camera FOV/pitch, path stone size) were saved but not yet verified in-browser.

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## 🎮 Aetheria — Jejak Sang Angin

Prototipe game open-world 3D di browser yang terinspirasi Genshin Impact. Dibuat dengan **Vite + Three.js**, tanpa aset eksternal — pulau, karakter, slime, dan efek dibuat secara prosedural.

### Menjalankan

```bash
npm install
npm run dev     # http://localhost:3002
npm run build   # hasil statis di dist/
```

### Kontrol

| Aksi | Keyboard | Sentuh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gerak | `WASD` | Joystick kiri |
| Lari | `Shift` | — |
| Lompat / Terbang | `Spasi` | Tombol lompat |
| Serang | `J` / klik kiri | Tombol pedang |
| Skill elemen | `E` | Tombol skill |
| Burst | `Q` | Tombol burst |
| Ganti karakter | `1` / `2` | Kartu karakter |
| Interaksi | `F` | Prompt interaksi |
| Jeda | `Esc` | Tombol jeda |

### Fitur

- Pulau terbuka dengan desa, bukit, pantai, danau, serta pulau melayang.
- Dua karakter dengan elemen berbeda: **Aria (Anemo)** dan **Ember (Pyro)**.
- Reaksi elemental (Uap, Kobar, Pusaran, Kejut, Ledakan) dengan skill dan burst.
- Slime musuh, Raja Slime Purba, bar HP, damage number, dan sistem respawn.
- Alur petualangan: bicara dengan Penjaga Awan → kumpulkan 3 Serpihan Angin → kalahkan 3 slime → buka peti kuno.
- Minimap, marker objek, dialog, toast, layar hadiah, jeda, dan layar tumbang.
- Dukungan desktop dan mobile: joystick, tombol aksi sentuh, serta layout safe-area.
- Deteksi renderer software (SwiftShader) dengan penurunan kualitas otomatis.
- Audio ambient dan efek suara prosedural melalui Web Audio.
